member.name: T:S3Lite.GatewayConfig
member.summary:
Settings for routing requests through an intermediate reverse proxy / gateway while the SigV4 signature stays bound to the upstream endpoint described by . Assign to (or pass to ) to enable gateway routing.
When set, the request is sent to this gateway host with its Host header set to this gateway host. The gateway is expected to rewrite the Host header to the authority the request was signed for - the upstream request authority - before forwarding upstream. That signed authority is not necessarily verbatim: for virtual-hosted-style requests it is bucket-prefixed (for example bucket.s3.us-west-1.example.com), and for path-style requests it is the bare endpoint (for example s3.us-west-1.example.com), including a non-standard port when one is configured. The SigV4 signature stays bound to that upstream authority, so it validates once the gateway has restored it.
This is NOT a forward/HTTP (CONNECT) proxy. For a forward proxy that preserves the upstream Host end-to-end, leave this unset and supply an HttpClient configured with a WebProxy instead (see ).

member.name: P:S3Lite.GatewayConfig.Hostname
member.summary: Gateway host that requests are sent to. This must be the bare gateway host only (for example s3.gateway.example.com); supply the protocol and port separately via and . When null or empty, no gateway routing is performed and requests go directly to .

member.name: P:S3Lite.GatewayConfig.BasePath
member.summary:
Base path prefix prepended to the signed upstream path when the request is sent to the gateway.
Like the Host rewrite, this changes only the path used for the HTTP connection; the SigV4 signature stays bound to the upstream path the request was signed for. Use this when the gateway mounts the upstream S3 endpoint under a sub-path (for example a request signed for /bucket/key is sent as /s3/bucket/key with BasePath = "/s3"). The gateway is expected to strip this prefix, restoring the signed path, before forwarding upstream.
A leading slash is added if omitted and a trailing slash is ignored, so "s3", "/s3" and "/s3/" are equivalent. When null or empty, no prefix is applied.
When is also set, it takes precedence and this value is ignored.

member.name: P:S3Lite.GatewayConfig.PathRewrite
member.summary:
Optional delegate that maps the signed upstream path (for example /bucket/key) to the path the request is actually sent to the gateway with. This is the general-purpose escape hatch for arbitrary path transforms; for the common "mount under a sub-path" case prefer .
Like , this changes only the connection path - the SigV4 signature stays bound to the upstream path passed in, and the gateway is expected to reverse the transform before forwarding upstream. The input is the absolute path only (the query string is preserved separately); return an absolute path beginning with /.
When set, this takes precedence over . When null, only (if any) is applied.

member.summary: Inject the W3C traceparent and tracestate headers of the current activity into outbound requests. The headers are added after signing, so they are not part of the SigV4 signature. Ignored when is false. Default is true.

member.name: P:S3Lite.TelemetrySettings.IncludeObjectKeys
member.summary: Record object keys (aws.s3.key) and exception messages (which embed request URLs) on spans. Object keys can carry user data, so this is off by default. Keys are never recorded on metrics. Default is false.

member.name: M:S3Lite.TelemetrySettings.#ctor
member.summary: Instantiate with defaults (enabled, metrics and traces on, propagation on, object keys off).
